import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Strip whitespace from island (label_variant)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip()
    # Clean body_mass_g: remove commas and parse as numeric (text_number)
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', ''), errors='coerce')
    # Set out-of-range body_mass_g to NaN (out_of_range)
    df.loc[(df['body_mass_g'] < 2500) | (df['body_mass_g'] > 6500), 'body_mass_g'] = pd.NA
    # Handle negative flipper_length_mm (negative)
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 0, 'flipper_length_mm'] = pd.NA
    # Remove exact duplicate rows (duplicates)
    df = df.drop_duplicates()
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    valid = df.dropna(subset=['sex', 'body_mass_g'])
    result = {}
    for sex, group in valid.groupby('sex'):
        result[sex] = group['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return result
